confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and beer anchors rest on a few aggregated sources (Expat Exchange, CityCost, Nomad Ranker, Mazurly) that disagree, especially on mid-range dinners, so the figures are bounded estimates. Cappuccino and cocktail anchors are weakly sourced: no Siargao menu prices were found, so they are estimated from Manila and general tourist-island pricing. Wine glass is derived from the beer anchor using a local price relationship, not direct observation. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Siargao's tourist-market context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX is the latest RBA observation found, which may not include same-day 4 pm figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Manila/Makati restaurant benchmarks, adjusted for Siargao's lower local prices and higher tourist-area prices in General Luna. Accommodation is benchmarked against typical Philippine island beach-town guesthouse and hostel rates, which is a model estimate.
